suggested_title: Kevin Wang - Resident Physician, Anesthesiology at Columbia VP&S / NYP
prospect_notes: Kevin Wang is a Cornell University undergraduate alumnus who completed his MD at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons. As a Cornell undergrad he was highly engaged in pre-health activities including Co-President of Cornell Alternative Breaks (leading an 84-student spring break service-learning program), President/Senior Advisor of Cornell Club of Taiwan, Planning Board Leader of Cornell Undergraduate Health Cooperative, and member of Alpha Epsilon Delta Pre-Health Honor Society. At Columbia VP&S he was Communications Chair of the VP&S Human Rights Initiative and Asylum Clinic, Education Chair of the Asian Pacific American Medical Students Association, and Vaccine Outreach Project Lead for the COVID-19 Student Service Corps. He matched into Anesthesiology and is now a Resident Physician at New York-Presbyterian/Columbia University Irving Medical Center. Likely Cornell class of 2018-2020.

suggested_title: Erik Williams - MD Candidate at Columbia Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons
prospect_notes: Erik Williams is a Cornell University undergraduate alumnus (approximately Cornell class of 2023) and is currently an MD Candidate at Columbia University Vagelos College of Physicians and Surgeons. At Cornell he conducted undergraduate research in the Fischbach Lab from January 2020 through May 2023, and served as a Teaching Assistant for BIOMI 2100 (introductory microbiology) from January to May 2023. His Cornell extracurriculars included Engineers Without Borders and Design by Biomedical Undergraduate Teams (DBTU). He also holds a JD from Cornell Law School and passed the New York Bar Exam, indicating a concurrent JD/MD or sequential degree pathway. His research interests include fibrotic extracellular matrix deposition and tumor invasion in the context of cancer metastasis. He has also worked at Angelini Ventures, a life sciences venture capital firm, applying data-driven approaches.
